d:
What are gravitational waves — and how do ripples in spacetime let us "hear" black holes collide a billion light-years away? In simple words, this animated explainer covers what gravitational waves are, what creates them, Einstein's 1916 prediction, and how LIGO finally detected them in 2015.
Whether you're a curious student, a physics enthusiast, or just someone who looked up at the night sky and wondered how we listen to the universe, this video breaks it all down from first principles.
CHAPTERS:
KEY TOPICS COVERED:
• What gravitational waves are — ripples in the fabric of spacetime
